item.text: I’m reconstructing the three repeated, scrambled copies, then I’ll apply the six operations in order and return only the requested result line.

item.command:
/bin/sh -lc "python - <<'PY'
from collections import Counter
s=open('.codex_box_scramble.txt').read().split()
c=Counter(s)
print(len(s),len(c),[(k,v) for k,v in c.items() if v%3])
for k in sorted(c): print(repr(k),c[k],c[k]//3)
PY"
